method: Full compose() was exercised against in-memory deep copies of the real accepted review; only the top-level review read was injected. Historical parent, source bytes, image checks, parser and geometry gates remained real. No mutant review, label or candidate file was written.

tests.name: replay_duplicate_against_inherited_new130_addition

mutation.expected_rejection: near-parent overlap review gate, not duplicate stable ID or count mismatch

tests.actual_error: addition overlaps a parent instance; review the complete parent labels, including inherited additions

overlap_gate_interpretation: IoU >= 0.75 triggers explicit parent-row, before-text and distinct-front review evidence; it is not proof of duplicate or distinct physical identity, and lower overlap is not proof that an addition is safe. The check includes inherited added rows.
